name: How long does it take to install new kitchen or bathroom lighting?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new kitchen or bathroom lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen or bathroom lighting installation depends on the scope of the project. A simple fixture replacement might take a few hours. A more extensive project involving new wiring, multiple recessed lights, or custom layouts could take one to several days. We provide a projected timeline during the initial consultation once we understand the full scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies: a few hours for simple replacement, several days for extensive projects with new wiring.
